description: This file is an HTML document that defines the structure and style of a web-based database viewer interface, including embedded JavaScript for client-side interactions and data fetching from an API.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets current selections, and reloads database list.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content based on data type and length, with support for expandable objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles toggling between collapsed and expanded view of cell content.
